analysis:
The PR adds a fixed accrual cutoff for Autopilot daily-floor rewards. EndsAt() returns 2026-11-08T00:00Z (exclusive) in coordinator/internal/payments/floorpolicy/math.go:12-16. ValidateDay rejects days at or after that cutoff (math.go:36-38). Engine.SettleClosedDays clamps closedBefore to EndsAt() (engine.go head hunk, around line 58), so the worker only lists days before the cutoff. Days earned earlier can still be settled after the cutoff, per the comment.

Security assessment: this tightens the payment-ledger surface (A-009 / TB-008) and adds no new input or privilege surface. I found no bypass in the visible code. Enrollments with NextDay >= closedBefore are skipped by the existing check at engine.go:69, and the More flag stays bounded.

Coverage limit: the store implementations (SettleAutopilotRewardDay, AutopilotRewardEnrollments) were not supplied. I could not confirm that the store enforces floorpolicy.ValidateDay or the cutoff itself on every settlement path, such as admin or alternate callers. If the cutoff is enforced only in the engine's listing loop and not in the store transaction, another caller could still settle days past November 7. Integration should check that all callers of SettleAutopilotRewardDay go through ValidateDay.

The CHANGELOG.md hunks are documentation only. They describe SSD cache, provider and coordinator changes that are not in this diff, so they are not a security behavior change here. They are consistent with the existing T-041 text.
